Players Committee card image of [[Scarif: Data Vault (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' While opponent occupies, Stardust (and any character it is on) may not move from here. '''Dark Side:''' All immunity to attrition (and Ephant Mon's game text) here is canceled.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/scarifdatavault_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c 6894629] (11 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
